quantity_units.uptake_constraints: each carries an explicit unit, source, mode and stoichiometric coefficients

quantity_units.scale: feature standard deviations; 1 for constant features

units.centre: per-feature model-native reporter response; appended growth is 1/h
units.loadings: latent basis coefficients in the recorded reporter feature basis
units.noise: mean squared reconstruction error in the model feature basis
units.readout: dimensionless module activity per latent coordinate, including intercept
